description: CTF crypto challenge playbook — read the provided encryption script like a spec, attack RSA parameter weaknesses, XOR/multi-time-pad oracles, and homemade ciphers with math tooling (z3, sympy, sage). Load when the handout is .py/.sage math, n/e/c values, or an "encryption service" on nc. Signals: "crypto" category, chall.py with Crypto.Util.number, e=3 or e=65537, "encrypted_flag", XOR with a key, nc service that encrypts your input.
